alerts.text: Claude Fable 5 — no extra cost on Pro & Max until Jun 22
alerts.dashboardText: Claude Fable 5 is here — state-of-the-art across coding, knowledge work, and research. Included at no extra cost on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans through June 22; from June 23 it moves to usage credits. Tap to try it.

alerts.text: Claude Fable 5 now uses usage credits
alerts.dashboardText: The no-extra-cost window for Claude Fable 5 on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise ended June 22. Using Fable 5 now draws on usage credits, until capacity allows it to return as standard. Tap to read more.
